---
id: ADR-0001
title: A point-in-time record with no standing rule
date: 2026-07-01
status: accepted
---

## Context and Problem Statement

Some decisions are point-in-time records worth logging but carry no
standing rule for future planning.

## Considered Options

- Record it as an ADR
- Leave it undocumented

## Decision Outcome

Recorded for the log; it establishes no rule, so it has no `## Rules`
section and never projects into constitution.md.
